documents.text: Fontaine Ministry The Fontaine Ministry formed the government of Luxembourg from 1 August 1848 to 2 December 1848. This had only become possible after popular unrest had broken out under governor Gaspard-Théodore-Ignace de la Fontaine in March 1848.
